title: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.13166v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Terminal agents are moving beyond local operations toward completing real-world professional tasks. Short trajectories can demonstrate commands and tool calls, but they do not fully show how agents accumulate evidence through exploration, use it to inform judgments, continually adjust strategies based on feedback, and turn intermediate results into final deliverables. High-quality long-horizon trajectories capture these agentic behavioral patterns and their connections within a single problem-solving process, providing richer experience for sustained autonomous work. However, environment synthesis may complete or simplify the key work underlying these patterns in advance and thus remove the need for exploration, implementation, and verification that the agent was meant to perform. To address this, we introduce TerminalHorizon, a fully automated data synthesis engine for long-horizon terminal agents. Starting from real-world professional

translated_title: 面向长程终端智能的智能体数据规模化扩展
translated_abstract: 终端智能体正在从本地操作迈向完成真实世界的专业任务。短轨迹虽然能够展示命令和工具调用，但无法充分体现智能体如何通过探索积累证据、利用证据辅助判断、根据反馈持续调整策略，以及将中间结果转化为最终交付成果。高质量的长程轨迹能够在单一问题求解过程中捕捉这些智能体行为模式及其内在联系，为持续性自主工作提供更丰富的经验。然而，环境合成可能预先完成或简化这些行为模式背后的关键工作，从而消除了智能体本应执行的探索、实施和验证环节。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 TerminalHorizon，一个面向长程终端智能体的全自动化数据合成引擎。该方法从真实世界的专业（任务出发），……
tldr: 提出 TerminalHorizon，一个面向长程终端智能体的全自动化数据合成引擎，通过避免环境合成预先完成关键工作，生成能真正激发智能体探索、实施与验证能力的高质量长程训练数据。
en_tdlr: We introduce TerminalHorizon, a fully automated data synthesis engine for long-horizon terminal agents, which generates high-quality training data without pre-completing key work, thereby preserving genuine opportunities for exploration, implementation, and verification.
